_doc: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report HOLIDAY exceptions, transcribed from https://ir.eia.gov/ngs/schedule.html (read 2026-09-30: 'Release Date | Day | Time | Holiday'). The normal rule (Thursday 10:30 a.m. ET for the week ending the previous Friday) and the OMB PFEI 2026 footnote 6 rule for unlisted holiday weeks live in calendar.py. Rows: [week_ending_friday, alternate_release_date_ET, time_ET]; the week is the one the release would normally have carried (release date minus the normal lag).

citations.ngs: https://ir.eia.gov/ngs/schedule.html (read 2026-09-30): standard '10:30 a.m. eastern time on Thursdays'; exceptions 2025-01-03 Fri 10:30 (New Year's Day), 2025-01-08 Wed 12:00 (National Day of Mourning), 2025-06-18 Wed 12:00 (Juneteenth), 2025-11-14 Fri 10:30 (Veterans Day), 2025-11-26 Wed 12:00 (Thanksgiving), 2025-12-29 Mon 12:00 (Christmas Day), 2025-12-31 Wed 12:00 (New Year's Day), 2026-11-13 Fri 10:30 (Veterans Day), 2026-11-25 Wed 12:00 (Thanksgiving). OMB PFEI 2026 p.3 lists the same 2026 dates
